findings.reason: without a plant, the node satisfies its done-when by cutting a passing real group and never exercises the route s4 now says it may close on.
findings.text: s4 now permits the first group to be "reported and not cut" when it misses the bar within the spend ceiling, but the section's only planted control is the sorting step's pipeline-defect run; nothing plants a group whose audited rate is above the bar and shows it reported with its rate after repair, its causes and its spend rather than cut, so the branch this change added is an assertion that cannot fail (§5 received exactly this control after the earlier review)

findings.reason: the threshold must be set from achievable reader performance with a stated correction, or the fallback must say how the deciding reader's measured error is carried into the bar and the group rate, otherwise §4 audits a 200-name group at 65 % recall/35 % false alarm while its evidence claims a fitness gate fired.
findings.text: s3 defines "fit to decide" as finding at least 90 % of the known-defective and flagging at most 10 % of the known-sound on the planted names, while the re-read the plan cites records 13 of 20 (65.0 %) known-defective found and 7 of 20 (35.0 %) known-sound flagged for the frontier reader, and 9 of 20 / 11 of 20 recall with 5 of 20 false alarms for the §1 readers (docs/evidence/fragments/sn-audited-group-release/frontier-third-reader.json, "planted"), so no measured reader meets it; at 20 + 20 plants a 90 %/10 % rule also carries an interval far wider than the twenty points §1 refuses to state a group rate from, so the threshold cannot discriminate; the fallback then lets the lead choose an unfit reader and requires only that its measured recall and false-alarm rate "be stated beside every rate it produces", never that the error be removed from the bar or from the §4 group rates — so the bar is fixed and every group is audited by a reader the section's own criterion rejects, which is precisely the basis the 2026-11-17 ruling calls too weak
